components.author: sdsremote
components.name: sdsremote-sbom-generator
components.description: Enriches syft's Dart inventory with lock hashes, exact-version licences, scopes and SDK components.

properties.name: sdsremote:sbom:scope
properties.value: runtime dependencies of the release; dev/test-only packages are included with scope=excluded

properties.name: sdsremote:license:method
properties.value: SPDX ids detected from the primary LICENSE/COPYING files of the exact locked versions in the pub cache (third-party notice files such as LICENSE-other.md excluded); pub.dev score tags only as fallback (they describe the latest version); bundled native libraries use the upstream project licence recorded in sdsremote:license:source

properties.name: sdsremote:sbom:nativeComponents
properties.value: Native libraries bundled by Flutter plugins are read from the plugin sources in the pub cache: whisper.cpp (whisper_ggml), ggml (whisper_ggml), libserialport (flutter_libserialport), pdfium (pdfium_dart)

components.name: ggml
components.description: Tensor library vendored in whisper.cpp and linked into the same plugin library.

properties.name: sdsremote:license:source
properties.value: whisper.cpp LICENSE (MIT); ggml is part of the vendored whisper.cpp tree

components.name: libserialport
components.description: Serial-port C library compiled and bundled by flutter_libserialport.

properties.name: sdsremote:license:source
properties.value: COPYING (LGPL-3.0) and the LGPL-3.0-or-later header in libserialport.h

components.name: pdfium
components.description: Prebuilt PDFium library downloaded by pdfium_dart from pdfium-binaries.

properties.name: sdsremote:license:status
properties.value: unknown: no LICENSE file in patched package

components.name: whisper.cpp
components.description: Speech-recognition engine vendored in whisper_ggml and compiled into the plugin.

properties.name: sdsremote:license:source
properties.value: whisper.cpp LICENSE (MIT) in the whisper_ggml source tree
